name: drawer
useFor: Use on phones for a short task or a choice that belongs to the page under it (pick a shipping address, review a cart). Set direction for top, left or right; bottom is the default. Mark a scrolling list inside it with data-drawer-no-drag so scrolling does not drag the drawer.
constraints: A drawer on desktop for a long form (use a sheet or dialog)
Content that needs the full height of the screen
A drawer opened from another drawer
source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/app/globals.css (.win) and sheet.tsx
title: Drawer
description: A window pulled from an edge with a handle, that can be dragged away.
